# Budget Home Fixes

> Cost breakdowns and side-by-side comparisons for home upgrades, written for renters and people on a tight budget. Every guide lists the sources it used, shows where sources disagree, and labels its own estimates. Articles are researched and written with AI assistance and fact-checked against the cited sources.

## Main sections
- [All guides](https://thebudgethomefixes.com/): latest cost guides
- [Painting](https://thebudgethomefixes.com/category/painting/)
- [Wallpaper](https://thebudgethomefixes.com/category/wallpaper/)
